data.name: welcomePageBody.Text
data.value:
This application updates the firmware of DigiTech RP-series devices only.
Supported models: RP150, RP155, RP250, RP255, RP350, RP355, BP355, RP500, RP1000.
Connect a supported device and power it on, then click Next. Firmware images are bundled with this application, so no internet connection is required.
All MIDI traffic is logged to Digitech RP Series Firmware Updater.log next to this program.
